entries.name: MDP
entries.statement: (𝓢 : Type u_1) → (𝓐 : Type u_2) → (𝓡 : Type u_3) → [MeasurableSpace 𝓢] → [MeasurableSpace 𝓐] → [MeasurableSpace 𝓡] → Type (max (max u_1 u_2) u_3)

entries.name: measurableSet_singleton_sigma
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : ι → Type u_2} [inst : (i : ι) → MeasurableSpace (α i)] [∀ (i : ι), MeasurableSingletonClass (α i)] (x : (i : ι) × α i), MeasurableSet {x}

entries.name: sub_mul_sub_div_sq_le
entries.statement: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] {m M μ : K}, 0 < m → 0 < M → 0 < μ → (M - μ) * (μ - m) / μ ^ 2 ≤ (M - m) ^ 2 / (4 * M * m)

entries.name: two_sub_le_inv
entries.statement: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] {x : K}, 0 < x → 2 - x ≤ x⁻¹

entries.name: ENat.toENNReal_le_ofReal_of_forall_natCast_le

entries.statement: ∀ {S : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype S] [inst_1 : Fintype A] [inst_2 : DecidableEq S] [inst_3 : DecidableEq A] [inst_4 : Nonempty A] {H t : ℕ} (hist : Learning.Hist Unit (Learning.MDP.Episodic.Policy S A H) (Learning.MDP.Episodic.Traj S H) t) (r : Fin H → S → A → ℝ) (β δ : ℝ) (h : Fin H) (s : S), Essakine2026Tight.cert r β δ hist (H - ↑h) s = if Essakine2026Tight.visitCount hist h s (Essakine2026Tight.greedy r β δ hist h s) = 0 then if 0 < β then Real.exp (β * (↑(H - 1 - ↑h) + 1)) else 1 else min (if 0 < β then Real.exp (β * (↑(H - 1 - ↑h) + 1)) else 1) (Real.exp (β * r h s (Essakine2026Tight.greedy r β δ hist h s)) * (↑3 * Essakine2026Tight.bonus (Fintype.card S) (Fintype.card A) H β δ (H - 1 - ↑h) (Essakine2026Tight.visitCount hist h s (Essakine2026Tight.greedy r β δ hist h s)) (Essakine2026Tight.empTrans hist h s (Essakine2026Tight.greedy r β δ hist h s)) (Essakine2026Tight.optZ r β δ hist (H - 1 - ↑h)).1 (Essakine2026Tight.optZ r β δ hist (H - 1 - ↑h)).2 + (1 + ↑3 / ↑H) * Learning.MDP.vecExp (Essakine2026Tight.empTrans hist h s (Essakine2026Tight.greedy r β δ hist h s)) (Essakine2026Tight.cert r β δ hist (H - 1 - ↑h))))

entries.name: Essakine2026Tight.vecExp_le_one_add_mul_vecExp_add
entries.statement: ∀ {S : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype S] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace S] [MeasurableSingletonClass S] {p q : S → ℝ} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure S} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure ν] {αn B H : ℝ}, (∀ (s : S), 0 ≤ p s) → ∑ s, p s = 1 → (∀ (s : S), ν.real {s} = q s) → 0 ≤ αn → 0 ≤ B → 1 ≤ H → ∀ {g : S → ℝ}, (∀ (s : S), g s ∈ Set.Icc 0 B) → InformationTheory.klDiv (MeasureTheory.weightedMeasure p) ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal αn → Learning.MDP.vecExp p g ≤ (1 + 1 / H) * Learning.MDP.vecExp q g + 2 * H * B * αn

entries.statement: ∀ {S : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype S] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace S] [MeasurableSingletonClass S] {p q : S → ℝ} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure S} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure ν] {αn B H : ℝ}, (∀ (s : S), 0 ≤ p s) → ∑ s, p s = 1 → (∀ (s : S), ν.real {s} = q s) → 0 ≤ αn → 0 ≤ B → 1 ≤ H → ∀ {f : S → ℝ}, (∀ (s : S), f s ∈ Set.Icc 0 B) → InformationTheory.klDiv (MeasureTheory.weightedMeasure p) ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal αn → Learning.MDP.vecExp q f - Learning.MDP.vecExp p f ≤ 1 / H * Learning.MDP.vecExp p f + (5 + 4 * H) * B * αn

entries.statement: ∀ {S : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype S] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace S] [MeasurableSingletonClass S] {p q : S → ℝ} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure S} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure ν] {a b c : ℝ} {f : S → ℝ}, (∀ (s : S), 0 ≤ p s) → ∑ s, p s = 1 → (∀ (s : S), ν.real {s} = q s) → 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → (∀ (s : S), f s ∈ Set.Icc c (c + b)) → InformationTheory.klDiv (MeasureTheory.weightedMeasure p) ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a → Learning.MDP.vecVar q f ≤ 2 * Learning.MDP.vecVar p f + 4 * b ^ 2 * a

entries.name: InformationTheory.abs_integral_sub_integral_le_of_klDiv_le
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {μ ν : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {f : α → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure ν], 0 < b → 0 ≤ a → (∀ᵐ (x : α) ∂ν, f x ∈ Set.Icc 0 b) → MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f ν → InformationTheory.klDiv μ ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a → |∫ (x : α), f x ∂μ - ∫ (x : α), f x ∂ν| ≤ √(2 * ProbabilityTheory.variance f ν * a) + 2 / 3 * b * a

entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : DecidableEq α] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace α] {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [MeasurableSingletonClass α] [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure ν] {x : ℕ → α} {n : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → (∀ k < n, ν {x k} ≠ 0) → Real.exp (↑n * (InformationTheory.klDiv (MeasureTheory.weightedMeasure (InformationTheory.empiricalFreq fun i => x ↑i)) ν).toReal) ≤ InformationTheory.laplaceRatio ν x n * ((↑n + 1) ^ (Fintype.card α - 1) * Real.exp 1 * √↑n)

entries.name: InformationTheory.integral_sub_integral_le_of_klDiv_le
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {μ ν : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {f : α → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure ν], 0 < b → 0 ≤ a → (∀ᵐ (x : α) ∂ν, f x ∈ Set.Icc 0 b) → MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f ν → InformationTheory.klDiv μ ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a → ∫ (x : α), f x ∂μ - ∫ (x : α), f x ∂ν ≤ √(2 * ProbabilityTheory.variance f ν * a) + 2 / 3 * b * a

entries.name: InformationTheory.integral_sub_log_integral_exp_le_of_klDiv_le

entries.name: InformationTheory.isProbabilityMeasure_weightedMeasure_empiricalFreq
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : DecidableEq α] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace α] {n : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → ∀ (y : Fin n → α), MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (MeasureTheory.weightedMeasure (InformationTheory.empiricalFreq y))

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBer
entries.statement: ℝ → ℝ → ENNReal

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBerReal
entries.statement: ℝ → ℝ → ℝ

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBerReal_apply
entries.statement: ∀ (p q : ℝ), InformationTheory.klBerReal p q = p * Real.log (p / q) + (1 - p) * Real.log ((1 - p) / (1 - q))

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBerReal_eq_neg_binEntropy_sub
entries.statement: ∀ {p q : ℝ}, q ≠ 0 → q ≠ 1 → InformationTheory.klBerReal p q = -Real.binEntropy p - p * Real.log q - (1 - p) * Real.log (1 - q)

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBerReal_eq_of_ne
entries.statement: ∀ {p q : ℝ}, q ≠ 0 → q ≠ 1 → InformationTheory.klBerReal p q = p * (Real.log p - Real.log q) + (1 - p) * (Real.log (1 - p) - Real.log (1 - q))

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBerReal_le_div
entries.statement: ∀ {p q : ℝ}, 0 ≤ p → p ≤ 1 → 0 < q → q < 1 → InformationTheory.klBerReal p q ≤ (p - q) ^ 2 / (q * (1 - q))

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBerReal_le_klBerReal_of_le_of_le
entries.statement: ∀ {p a b : ℝ}, p ≤ a → a ≤ b → 0 < a → b < 1 → InformationTheory.klBerReal p a ≤ InformationTheory.klBerReal p b

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBerReal_le_klBerReal_of_le_of_le'
entries.statement: ∀ {p a b : ℝ}, b ≤ p → a ≤ b → 0 < a → b < 1 → InformationTheory.klBerReal p b ≤ InformationTheory.klBerReal p a

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBerReal_one_left
entries.statement: ∀ {q : ℝ}, InformationTheory.klBerReal 1 q = -Real.log q

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBerReal_one_sub
entries.statement: ∀ (p q : ℝ), InformationTheory.klBerReal (1 - p) (1 - q) = InformationTheory.klBerReal p q

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBerReal_self
entries.statement: ∀ (p : ℝ), InformationTheory.klBerReal p p = 0

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBerReal_zero_left
entries.statement: ∀ {q : ℝ}, InformationTheory.klBerReal 0 q = -Real.log (1 - q)

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBer_eq_ofReal
entries.statement: ∀ {p q : ℝ}, q ≠ 0 → q ≠ 1 → InformationTheory.klBer p q = ENNReal.ofReal (InformationTheory.klBerReal p q)

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBer_eq_top_iff
entries.statement: ∀ {p q : ℝ}, InformationTheory.klBer p q = ⊤ ↔ q = 0 ∧ p ≠ 0 ∨ q = 1 ∧ p ≠ 1

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBer_le_max
entries.statement: ∀ {p q q₁ q₂ : ℝ}, 0 ≤ q₁ → q₁ ≤ q → q ≤ q₂ → q₂ ≤ 1 → InformationTheory.klBer p q ≤ max (InformationTheory.klBer p q₁) (InformationTheory.klBer p q₂)

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBer_le_of_tendsto
entries.statement: ∀ {a b : ℝ} {x y : ℕ → ℝ} {D : ENNReal}, (∀ (n : ℕ), x n ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) → (∀ (n : ℕ), y n ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) → Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds a) → Filter.Tendsto y Filter.atTop (nhds b) → (∀ (n : ℕ), InformationTheory.klBer (x n) (y n) ≤ D) → InformationTheory.klBer a b ≤ D

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBer_le_of_tendsto_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {a : ℝ} {x y : ℕ → ℝ} {D : ENNReal}, (∀ (n : ℕ), x n ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) → (∀ (n : ℕ), y n ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) → Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds a) → Filter.Tendsto y Filter.atTop (nhds 0) → (∀ (n : ℕ), InformationTheory.klBer (x n) (y n) ≤ D) → InformationTheory.klBer a 0 ≤ D

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBer_measureReal_le_klDiv
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ ν : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {A : Set Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure ν], MeasurableSet A → InformationTheory.klBer (μ.real A) (ν.real A) ≤ InformationTheory.klDiv μ ν

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBer_one_left

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBer_one_right
entries.statement: ∀ {p : ℝ}, InformationTheory.klBer p 1 = if p = 1 then 0 else ⊤

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBer_one_sub

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBer_zero_right

entries.name: InformationTheory.klDiv_bernoulliMeasure

entries.name: InformationTheory.laplaceRatio
entries.statement: {α : Type u_1} → [Fintype α] → [DecidableEq α] → [inst : MeasurableSpace α] → MeasureTheory.Measure α → (ℕ → α) → ℕ → ℝ

entries.name: InformationTheory.laplaceRatio_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : DecidableEq α] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace α] (ν : MeasureTheory.Measure α) (x : ℕ → α) (n : ℕ), InformationTheory.laplaceRatio ν x n = (∏ a, ↑(InformationTheory.typeCount (fun i => x ↑i) a).factorial) / ↑((Fintype.card α).ascFactorial n) / ∏ k ∈ Finset.range n, ν.real {x k}

entries.name: InformationTheory.laplaceRatio_le
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : DecidableEq α] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace α] {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure α} (x : ℕ → α) (n : ℕ), InformationTheory.laplaceRatio ν x n ≤ (∑ a, (ν.real {a})⁻¹) ^ n

entries.name: InformationTheory.laplaceRatio_nonneg
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : DecidableEq α] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace α] (ν : MeasureTheory.Measure α) (x : ℕ → α) (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ InformationTheory.laplaceRatio ν x n

entries.name: InformationTheory.laplaceRatio_succ
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : DecidableEq α] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace α] (ν : MeasureTheory.Measure α) (x : ℕ → α) (n : ℕ), InformationTheory.laplaceRatio ν x (n + 1) = InformationTheory.laplaceRatio ν x n * ((↑(InformationTheory.typeCount (fun i => x ↑i) (x n)) + 1) / (↑n + ↑(Fintype.card α)) / ν.real {x n})

entries.name: InformationTheory.laplaceRatio_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : DecidableEq α] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace α] (ν : MeasureTheory.Measure α) (x : ℕ → α), InformationTheory.laplaceRatio ν x 0 = 1

entries.name: InformationTheory.one_div_le_laplaceRatio
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : DecidableEq α] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace α] {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [MeasurableSingletonClass α] [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure ν] {x : ℕ → α} {n : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → (∀ k < n, ν {x k} ≠ 0) → ∀ {δ : ℝ}, 0 < δ → ENNReal.ofReal ((Real.log (1 / δ) + ↑(Fintype.card α - 1) * Real.log (↑n + 1) + 1 + Real.log ↑n / 2) / ↑n) ≤ InformationTheory.klDiv (MeasureTheory.weightedMeasure (InformationTheory.empiricalFreq fun i => x ↑i)) ν → 1 / δ ≤ InformationTheory.laplaceRatio ν x n

entries.name: InformationTheory.sum_klDiv_compProd_restrict_lt_eq_lintegral
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {X : ℕ → Type u_2} [inst : (n : ℕ) → MeasurableSpace (X n)] {Z : (n : ℕ) → Ω → X n} {τ : Ω → WithTop ℕ} {κ κ' : (n : ℕ) → ProbabilityTheory.Kernel ((i : Fin n) → X ↑i) (X n)} [∀ (n : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel (κ n)] [∀ (n : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel (κ' n)] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] [∀ (n : ℕ), MeasurableSpace.CountablyGenerated (X n)], (∀ (n : ℕ), Measurable (Z n)) → Measurable τ → ∀ (M : ℕ), ∑ t ∈ Finset.range M, InformationTheory.klDiv ((MeasureTheory.Measure.map (ProbabilityTheory.finPrefix Z t) (P.restrict {ω | ↑t < τ ω})).compProd (κ t)) ((MeasureTheory.Measure.map (ProbabilityTheory.finPrefix Z t) (P.restrict {ω | ↑t < τ ω})).compProd (κ' t)) = ∫⁻ (ω : Ω), ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (min (τ ω) ↑M).toNat, InformationTheory.klDiv ((κ t) (ProbabilityTheory.finPrefix Z t ω)) ((κ' t) (ProbabilityTheory.finPrefix Z t ω)) ∂P

entries.name: InformationTheory.tsum_klDiv_compProd_restrict_lt_eq_lintegral
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {X : ℕ → Type u_2} [inst : (n : ℕ) → MeasurableSpace (X n)] {Z : (n : ℕ) → Ω → X n} {τ : Ω → WithTop ℕ} {κ κ' : (n : ℕ) → ProbabilityTheory.Kernel ((i : Fin n) → X ↑i) (X n)} [∀ (n : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel (κ n)] [∀ (n : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel (κ' n)] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] [∀ (n : ℕ), MeasurableSpace.CountablyGenerated (X n)], (∀ (n : ℕ), Measurable (Z n)) → Measurable τ → (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, τ ω ≠ ⊤) → ∑' (t : ℕ), InformationTheory.klDiv ((MeasureTheory.Measure.map (ProbabilityTheory.finPrefix Z t) (P.restrict {ω | ↑t < τ ω})).compProd (κ t)) ((MeasureTheory.Measure.map (ProbabilityTheory.finPrefix Z t) (P.restrict {ω | ↑t < τ ω})).compProd (κ' t)) = ∫⁻ (ω : Ω), ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (ENat.toNat (τ ω)), InformationTheory.klDiv ((κ t) (ProbabilityTheory.finPrefix Z t ω)) ((κ' t) (ProbabilityTheory.finPrefix Z t ω)) ∂P

entries.name: InformationTheory.variance_le_two_mul_variance_add_of_klDiv_le

entries.name: ProbabilityTheory.measure_exists_log_le_selfNorm_poissonCramer_le
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {ℱ : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ mΩ} {Y w v : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {b : ℝ} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ], 0 < b → (∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable (Y i)) → (∀ (i : ℕ), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, |Y i ω| ≤ b) → (∀ (i : ℕ), μ[Y i | ↑ℱ i] =ᵐ[μ] 0) → (∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable (w i)) → (∀ (i : ℕ) (ω : Ω), w i ω ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) → (∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable (v i)) → (∀ (i : ℕ) (ω : Ω), v i ω ∈ Set.Icc 0 (b ^ 2)) → (∀ (i : ℕ), μ[fun ω => Y i ω ^ 2 | ↑ℱ i] =ᵐ[μ] v i) → ∀ {δ : ℝ}, 0 < δ → μ {ω | ∃ t, Real.log (1 / δ) + Real.log (8 * (1 + √(2 * ↑t))) ≤ (ProbabilityTheory.selfNormVar v w t ω / b ^ 2 + 1) * (b * |ProbabilityTheory.selfNormSum Y w t ω| / (ProbabilityTheory.selfNormVar v w t ω + b ^ 2)).poissonCramer} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ

entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {ℱ : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ mΩ} {Y w v : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {b : ℝ} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ], 0 < b → (∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable (Y i)) → (∀ (i : ℕ), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, |Y i ω| ≤ b) → (∀ (i : ℕ), μ[Y i | ↑ℱ i] =ᵐ[μ] 0) → (∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable (w i)) → (∀ (i : ℕ) (ω : Ω), w i ω ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) → (∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable (v i)) → (∀ (i : ℕ) (ω : Ω), v i ω ∈ Set.Icc 0 (b ^ 2)) → (∀ (i : ℕ), μ[fun ω => Y i ω ^ 2 | ↑ℱ i] =ᵐ[μ] v i) → ∀ {δ : ℝ}, 0 < δ → μ {ω | ∃ t, Real.log (1 / δ) + Real.log (4 * Real.exp 1 * (2 * ↑t + 1)) ≤ (ProbabilityTheory.selfNormVar v w t ω / b ^ 2 + 1) * (b * |ProbabilityTheory.selfNormSum Y w t ω| / (ProbabilityTheory.selfNormVar v w t ω + b ^ 2)).poissonCramer} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ

entries.name: ProbabilityTheory.measure_exists_sqrt_add_lt_abs_selfNormSum_le
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {ℱ : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ mΩ} {Y w v : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {b : ℝ} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ], 0 < b → (∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable (Y i)) → (∀ (i : ℕ), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, |Y i ω| ≤ b) → (∀ (i : ℕ), μ[Y i | ↑ℱ i] =ᵐ[μ] 0) → (∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable (w i)) → (∀ (i : ℕ) (ω : Ω), w i ω ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) → (∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable (v i)) → (∀ (i : ℕ) (ω : Ω), v i ω ∈ Set.Icc 0 (b ^ 2)) → (∀ (i : ℕ), μ[fun ω => Y i ω ^ 2 | ↑ℱ i] =ᵐ[μ] v i) → ∀ {δ : ℝ}, 0 < δ → δ < 1 → μ {ω | ∃ t, √(2 * (ProbabilityTheory.selfNormVar v w t ω + b ^ 2) * Real.log (4 * Real.exp 1 * (2 * ↑t + 1) / δ)) + 2 / 3 * b * Real.log (4 * Real.exp 1 * (2 * ↑t + 1) / δ) < |ProbabilityTheory.selfNormSum Y w t ω|} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ

entries.name: ProbabilityTheory.measure_exists_sqrt_add_lt_abs_selfNormSum_le'
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {ℱ : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ mΩ} {Y w v : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {b : ℝ} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ], 0 < b → (∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable (Y i)) → (∀ (i : ℕ), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, |Y i ω| ≤ b) → (∀ (i : ℕ), μ[Y i | ↑ℱ i] =ᵐ[μ] 0) → (∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable (w i)) → (∀ (i : ℕ) (ω : Ω), w i ω ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) → (∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable (v i)) → (∀ (i : ℕ) (ω : Ω), v i ω ∈ Set.Icc 0 (b ^ 2)) → (∀ (i : ℕ), μ[fun ω => Y i ω ^ 2 | ↑ℱ i] =ᵐ[μ] v i) → ∀ {δ : ℝ}, 0 < δ → δ < 1 → μ {ω | ∃ t, √(2 * ProbabilityTheory.selfNormVar v w t ω * Real.log (4 * Real.exp 1 * (2 * ↑t + 1) / δ)) + 3 * b * Real.log (4 * Real.exp 1 * (2 * ↑t + 1) / δ) < |ProbabilityTheory.selfNormSum Y w t ω|} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ

entries.name: ProbabilityTheory.measure_exists_sqrt_add_lt_abs_sum_sub_integral_le
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {ξ : ℕ → Ω → α} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {g : α → ℝ} {b δ : ℝ}, (∀ (i : ℕ), Measurable (ξ i)) → ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun ξ μ → (∀ (i : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw (ξ i) ν μ) → Measurable g → (∀ (x : α), |g x - ∫ (y : α), g y ∂ν| ≤ b) → 0 < δ → δ < 1 → μ {ω | ∃ n, √(2 * (↑n * ∫ (x : α), (g x - ∫ (y : α), g y ∂ν) ^ 2 ∂ν) * Real.log (4 * Real.exp 1 * (2 * ↑n + 1) / δ)) + 3 * b * Real.log (4 * Real.exp 1 * (2 * ↑n + 1) / δ) < |∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (g (ξ i ω) - ∫ (y : α), g y ∂ν)|} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ

entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSingletonClass X] {x y : X} {q : ↑unitInterval} [inst_2 : DecidableEq X], x ≠ y → ∀ (p : ↑unitInterval), q ≠ 0 → q ≠ 1 → (ProbabilityTheory.bernoulliMeasure x y p).rnDeriv (ProbabilityTheory.bernoulliMeasure x y q) =ᵐ[ProbabilityTheory.bernoulliMeasure x y q] fun z => if z = x then ENNReal.ofReal (↑p / ↑q) else ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - ↑p) / (1 - ↑q))

entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {ℱ : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ mΩ} {Y w v : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {b : ℝ} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ], 0 < b → (∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable (Y i)) → (∀ (i : ℕ), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, |Y i ω| ≤ b) → (∀ (i : ℕ), μ[Y i | ↑ℱ i] =ᵐ[μ] 0) → (∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable (w i)) → (∀ (i : ℕ) (ω : Ω), w i ω ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) → (∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable (v i)) → (∀ (i : ℕ) (ω : Ω), v i ω ∈ Set.Icc 0 (b ^ 2)) → (∀ (i : ℕ), μ[fun ω => Y i ω ^ 2 | ↑ℱ i] =ᵐ[μ] v i) → ∀ {i j : ℕ}, i ≤ j → ∀ {A : Set Ω}, MeasurableSet A → ∫⁻ (ω : Ω) in A, ProbabilityTheory.bernsteinMixture b (ProbabilityTheory.selfNormSum Y w j ω) (ProbabilityTheory.selfNormVar v w j ω) ∂μ ≤ ∫⁻ (ω : Ω) in A, ProbabilityTheory.bernsteinMixture b (ProbabilityTheory.selfNormSum Y w i ω) (ProbabilityTheory.selfNormVar v w i ω) ∂μ
